mechanism: Vendor master control layer: account created and approved by the same user, followed by rapid invoice-and-payment cycles with an unresolvable contract reference.

claims.assertion: Vendor account 209101 (Ratio Consulting) was created and approved by the same user MV-U05 on 12.05.2025.
The five consulting invoices from vendor 209101 in FY2025 sum to a net amount of 248,000.00 EUR (gross 295,120.00 EUR).
Each of the five invoices of vendor 209101 was paid within 2 days of the invoice posting date.
The posting texts of vendor 209101 cite a 'Rahmenvertrag' for which no document is found within the provided and parsed material.

missing_evidence: framework contract not present in provided material
no independent approval of vendor creation
pbc_requests: Request the Rahmenvertrag cited in the posting texts of vendor 209101
Request service-acceptance documentation for the five consulting invoices
innocence_checked: goods/service receipt exists: none found in scope (Wareneingangsliste covers material/logistics only)
vendor has prior normal history: none, account created 12.05.2025

mechanism: Asset ledger layer: repair-described expenditures recorded as asset additions instead of period expense.

No technical assessment supporting capitalization of the six repair-described items is found within the provided and parsed material.

expected_evidence: technical assessment distinguishing component replacement from repair
missing_evidence: technical assessment not present in provided material
pbc_requests: Request technical assessments for invoices ER901421-ER901426
innocence_checked: capitalizable component replacement documented: no documentation found
depreciation started normally: asset cards exist, depreciation start recorded

mechanism: Accrual layer: December-2025 service dates invoiced in January 2026; recorded accrual does not cover the invoiced amounts.

claims.assertion: Eight vendor invoices dated January 2026 (vendors 209130-209137) with service dates in December 2025 sum to 192,000.00 EUR and match eight goods receipts marked 'Dez-Lieferung, Rechnung offen'.
An accrual of 86,500.00 EUR 'unfakturierte Leistungen' exists at 31.12.2025; no subset of the eight invoices sums to this amount.

Potential unmatched liability of between 105,500.00 EUR and 192,000.00 EUR at 31.12.2025, depending on the undetermined relation of the 86,500.00 EUR accrual to the eight invoices; the profit-and-loss effect requires item-by-item confirmation and is not asserted here.

value.formula: 192000.00 - 86500.00 (lower bound; upper bound 192000.00 if accrual unrelated)

expected_evidence: per-invoice accrual linkage or documented estimation basis
missing_evidence: accrual coverage of the eight December service invoices not demonstrable from provided material
pbc_requests: Request the calculation basis of the 86,500.00 EUR accrual 'unfakturierte Leistungen'
innocence_checked: matching accrual exists per invoice: no per-invoice linkage found
accrual is a documented estimate covering the deliveries: no basis found in scope
service period actually in 2026: contradicted by Leistungsdatum fields

Each of the four payments is below the 10,000.00 EUR dual-approval limit defined in the audit planning document, while their same-document total exceeds it.
